_how_to_add: One object per partner in "partners": { "name": "…", "role": "what it does for us, one short line", "url": "https://…" }. A company belongs here only where the studio has a live account with it and can point at the work it does — the band stays hidden while this list is empty, and nothing here is invented. No logos: a logo is a trademark we have not been given permission to place, so the name carries the claim in text.
